job.title: Registered General Nurse (RGN) – Care Home
job.description:
Registered General Nurse (RGN) – Care Home
Location: South West London
Employer: Fire Group
Job Type: Flexible / Shift Work
Pay: Competitive rates ( 25.00 – 27.00 ) negotiable depending on experience

About the Role
Fire Group is recruiting experienced and dedicated Registered General Nurses (RGNs) to work within care homes across South West London.
We are looking for compassionate, reliable and professional nurses committed to delivering high-quality, person-centred care.

Key Responsibilities
  • Deliver safe, effective and person-centred nursing care.
  • Administer medication safely and accurately in line with care home policies.
  • Complete medication rounds and maintain accurate medication records.
  • Monitor residents' health and respond appropriately to changes in condition.
  • Maintain accurate clinical documentation and care plans.
  • Support and supervise care staff where required.
  • Liaise with GPs, healthcare professionals, residents and families.
  • Follow safeguarding and infection prevention procedures.
  • Promote residents' dignity, respect and independence.

﻿Essential Requirements

Applicants must have:
  • A valid and active NMC PIN.
  • Relevant nursing qualifications and registration.
  • A valid Enhanced DBS registered on the Update Service.
  • Relevant medication management training and competency.
  • Valid and up-to-date mandatory training certificates, or be willing to complete refresher training where required.
  • Previous nursing experience, preferably within a care home environment.
  • A good understanding of safeguarding and clinical care standards.
  • Excellent communication and organisational skills.
  • The ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Flexibility and willingness to work a variety of shift patterns.
What Fire Group Offers
  • Competitive and negotiable pay rates.
  • Flexible shift opportunities.
  • Opportunities within established care home settings.
  • Ongoing support from the Fire Group team.
  • A straightforward compliance and onboarding process.
How to Apply
If you are a qualified Registered Nurse with an active NMC PIN, an Enhanced DBS on the Update Service and the relevant experience, we would love to hear from you.
Please apply through Indeed with an up-to-date CV.
Suitable applicants will be contacted to discuss opportunities and complete our compliance process.

job.title: Maintenance Manager
job.description:
Maintenance Manager - Hospitality
Location: Southampton, Hampshire 
Salary: £40-45K DOE

We are working with a growing hospitality group to recruit an experienced Maintenance Manager to take ownership of its maintenance operation across a varied portfolio of properties.

This is an exciting opportunity for a senior maintenance or facilities professional to make a real impact. The business is developing a more structured and proactive approach to property maintenance, and this role will play a key part in putting effective systems, processes and standards in place.

About the Role

Reporting to senior management, you will take overall responsibility for the maintenance function, working closely with management and operational teams across the property portfolio.

A key focus will be moving the business towards a more planned and preventative maintenance model, reducing reliance on reactive repairs and ensuring properties, equipment and facilities remain safe, compliant and operating effectively.

Your responsibilities will include:
  • Taking overall responsibility for maintenance across a multi-site property portfolio.
  • Developing and implementing effective PPM systems and maintenance schedules.
  • Establishing structured asset management, servicing and maintenance records.
  • Ensuring statutory testing, inspections and certification are completed within required timescales.
  • Carrying out regular site inspections, identifying priorities, risks and opportunities for improvement.
  • Overseeing planned and reactive maintenance activity.
  • Managing contractors and specialist suppliers, ensuring work is completed to the required standard and represents value for money.
  • Managing maintenance budgets, purchasing and expenditure.
  • Identifying recurring issues and implementing longer-term solutions.
  • Supporting refurbishment, improvement and capital expenditure projects.
  • Producing maintenance and KPI reports to support senior management and drive continuous improvement.
What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is practical, organised and commercially aware, with the confidence to take ownership of a multi-site maintenance function.

You should have:
  • Previous experience in a Maintenance Manager, Facilities Manager or similar senior role.
  • Experience within hospitality, hotels, facilities management or a multi-property environment.
  • Strong knowledge of building maintenance and building services.
  • Experience developing or managing planned preventative maintenance programmes.
  • Good knowledge of statutory compliance and health & safety requirements.
  • Experience managing contractors, suppliers and maintenance budgets.
  • Strong leadership, planning and organisational skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • A proactive and hands-on approach.
  • Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively with operational teams and senior management.
  • A full UK driving licence and flexibility to travel regularly between properties.
A relevant qualification in Mechanical, Electrical, Engineering, Building Services or Facilities Management would be advantageous. IOSH, NEBOSH or experience with maintenance management/CMMS systems would also be beneficial.

Why Consider This Opportunity?
This is an opportunity to help shape and develop the maintenance operation of a growing hospitality business, with the scope to introduce new systems, strengthen compliance, improve preventative maintenance and establish consistent standards across a diverse property portfolio.

If you're an experienced Maintenance Manager looking for a role where you can take ownership, make improvements and have a genuine impact across multiple properties, we'd be keen to hear from you.

Apply today for a confidential discussion about the role.
